summary: Adds local account setup, optional history PIN lock, and safer sync-device registration.

new_features: First launch now sets up a local account while making clear that gTimer can run without device sync.
Added an optional PIN lock for previous-dose History and Map views while keeping dose recording available.
minor_improvements: Device sync now creates a device id only when a sync trial or gTimer Pro registration is used.
The Android and Windows parity plan now records the local-account, PIN-lock, and delayed device-id rules.
bug_fixes: Repeated sync registration from the same app install now reuses one active device record instead of creating duplicate devices.
